Right half contains three stacked panels: Activation Function (top), Training (middle), Evaluation (bottom).

layout.hierarchy: Title is largest text. Section headers (Positive Class, Negative Class, Training, Evaluation) are medium-sized colored text. Diagram labels are smaller. The airplane sketches and sigmoid graph provide visual anchors.

visual_elements.description: Five hand-drawn/sketch style airplanes in a red-bordered vertical box, each on a separate row with horizontal dividers. Some planes appear to have enemy markings.
Five hand-drawn/sketch style airplanes in a green-bordered vertical box, each on a separate row with horizontal dividers. Planes appear unmarked/friendly.
Pink vertical column with five '+1' entries aligned to positive class rows and five '0' entries aligned to negative class rows, under the header 'Label'.
Sigmoid function S-curve plot with x and y axes, showing a curve rising from bottom-left to top-right, passing through middle.

Training flow: Input Sample (rounded rect) → Model (red rect with sigmoid icon) → Predicted Class (circle) → LOSS (orange circle) → Label of Input Sample (circle). Model has subtext '(Any value → (0, +1))'. Final label shows '(+1, 0)'.
Evaluation flow: Test Sample (rounded rect) → Model (red rect with sigmoid icon) → Predicted Class (circle with '(+1, 0)'). Model has subtext '(Any value → (0, +1))'.
Small sigmoid curve icon inside the Model box in both Training and Evaluation flows.

imagery: Ten simple line-drawing/sketch airplanes, five in positive class column and five in negative class column, black outline on white background, arranged vertically with one per row
Small sigmoid S-curve graph in the Activation Function panel
Small sigmoid curve icon inside each Model box
typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is bold and larger. Section headers (Positive Class, Negative Class, Training, Evaluation) are bold and colored. Body labels are regular weight. 'Shoot the Enemy' and 'Safe' are in quotes. Mathematical ranges use parentheses and plus signs.
animation_state: No visible mid-build animation; all elements appear fully rendered.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F0F0F0). 2. Add a blue-bordered white box at top-left with bold black title 'Training Samples with Labels (Two Classes)'. 3. Add a yellow circle at top-right with black text '20'. 4. Create left section: red-bordered box with red header 'Positive Class', black subtext '"Shoot the Enemy"', and five rows of simple airplane sketches. 5. Add pink vertical column to the right of positive class with header 'Label' and five '+1' entries. 6. Create green-bordered box to the right with green header 'Negative Class', black subtext '"Safe"', and five rows of simple airplane sketches. 7. Add five '0' entries in the pink column aligned to negative class rows. 8. Create top-right panel with light purple background: header 'Activation Function', text 'Sigmoid function (0, +1)', text 'Threshold at "0.5"', and a small sigmoid S-curve graph. 9. Create middle-right panel with light yellow background: red header 'Training'. Add flowchart left-to-right: rounded rect 'Input Sample' → red rect 'Model' with subtext '(Any value → (0, +1))' and small sigmoid icon → circle 'Predicted Class' → orange circle 'LOSS' → circle 'Label of Input Sample' with subtext '(+1, 0)'. Connect with black arrows. 10. Create bottom-right panel with light yellow background: red header 'Evaluation'. Add flowchart: rounded rect 'Test Sample' → red rect 'Model' with subtext '(Any value → (0, +1))' and sigmoid icon → circle 'Predicted Class' with subtext '(+1, 0)'. Connect with black arrows.
